items.headline: Upcoming IPOs with shareholder quota: Reliance Retail, JSW One, IGX, Mahanadi Coalfields & more
items.summary: Many investors applied for the Jio Platforms IPO under the shareholder quota, which was reserved for eligible Reliance Industries shareholders. Mahanadi Coalfields, South Eastern Coalfields, Indian Gas Exchange, and Reliance Retail are among the list of upcoming IPOs likely to have a shareholder quota.

items.headline: HDFC Bank shares fall over 1% amid market weakness; stock turns positive over 6 months
items.summary: HDFC Bank shares have shown signs of recovery after a challenging phase earlier this year, following several years of underperformance largely attributed to the merger of HDFC Ltd with the bank.

items.headline: SENSEX slides over 600 pts, NIFTY50 opens lower at 25,209 amid weak global cues; IndiGo, Jio Fin, HDFC Bank lead top losers
items.summary: The Indian stock market indices declined after a negative open on Friday, November 13, with investors booking profits amid weak global cues. Here are key things to know about today's fall.

items.headline: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang quits: 7 Indian AI, semiconductor and data-centre stocks that could be in focus
items.summary: Semiconductor, AI and data-centre-linked stocks are likely to remain in focus and may see a knee-jerk reaction on Friday, November 13, amid concerns over the leadership transition at the global chipmaker.

items.headline: Market wrap, Nov 12: NIFTY50 ends at 25,229, SENSEX flat; NIFTY Smallcap 100 outperforms for second straight session

items.headline: SENSEX off the day’s high, NIFTY trades flat in noon deals; Bajaj Finance, Cupid, Ola Electric among buzzing stocks

items.headline: SBI, IOB, PNB shares fly high; NIFTY PSU Bank index surges 15% in a month
items.summary: While Indian Overseas Bank has received approval to raise up to ₹5,000 crore through a qualified institutional placement (QIP), Punjab & Sind Bank and Central Bank of India are also evaluating fundraising options.

items.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX trade higher after negative open on Nov 12; M&M, Bharti Airtel, IT stocks among top losers
items.summary: Indian equity indices recovered their weak opening during the early hours on Thursday, November 12, as investors focues on the positive global cues amid FII support in the market.

items.headline: ITC shares rise 2% amid reports of cigarette price hikes; here is what we know so far
items.summary: According to news reports, ITC has raised the price of its Gold Flake RSFT cigarette pack by around 8% to ₹135 from ₹125 earlier, marking another price hike for the brand this year.

items.headline: Stocks to watch, Nov 12: Bharat Dynamics, HAL, Bajaj Finance, Tata Power, Aurobindo Pharma, IRCTC, Page Industries
items.summary: Tata Power on Wednesday posted a record net profit of ₹1,652 crore for the September quarter (Q2 FY27), on the back of strong performance across all business segments.

items.headline: Top gainers and losers, Nov 11: M&M, IndiGo shares soar 4%, Trent rises 3%, Adani Port falls 2%; check list
items.summary: On November 11, the 30-share BSE SENSEX rose by 772.75 points or 0.95% to close at 81,879.40, while NIFTY ended higher by 0.84% or 210.40 points at 25,255.05.

items.headline: Market Wrap, Nov 11: SENSEX, NIFTY50 rise 1% as banking stocks rally; NIFTY Smallcap 100 outshines, M&M top gainers
items.summary: Both the benchmark indices touched their highest levels in nearly nine months, with the 50-share index rising to an intraday high of 25,424, a level last seen on February 27, 2026.

items.headline: NIFTY Bank reclaims 61,000: HDFC Bank, Axis Bank, Federal Bank, other banking stocks rally up to 6%; here's why
items.summary: Banking stocks surging up to 6% powered the NIFTY Bank index to reclaim its position above 61,000 levels, near its lifetime high, as investors focus on the broader market rally amid FII buying support.

items.headline: Crude oil at 2-month low: HPCL, BPCL, Asian Paints, IndiGo shares rally; here's why
items.summary: Brent crude futures fell $1.08, or 1.2%, to settle at $91.49 per barrel, while US West Texas Intermediate (WTI) crude declined 81 cents, or 0.9%, to $86.04 per barrel on Tuesday.

items.headline: NIFTY50, SENSEX rally over 1% after opening higher, IndiGo, M&M, among gainers; check factors behind today's surge
items.summary: Indian equity indices rallied over 1% after opening higher on Wednesday, November 11, with key focus on lower crude oil prices, massive FII buying support and positive geopolitical sentiment in the market.

items.headline: Can Reliance Industries disrupt India’s biscuit market like cola? Britannia CEO weighs in; stocks in focus
items.summary: Reliance Consumer Products Ltd (RCPL), the FMCG arm of RIL, has expanded its Independence biscuit portfolio with 28 new stock-keeping units (SKUs) across nine variants.

items.headline: Top gainers and losers on Nov 9: SBI, Trent up 2%, Nestle gains 1.9%; Tata Steel, HCL Tech drop over 2% among top movers
items.summary: As the equity indices end higher after a turbulent session on November 9, stocks like SBI, Trent, and Nestle India emerged as top gainers, while others like Tata Steel, and IT stocks among others were subject to selling pressure.

items.summary: The market breadth was in favour of declines as 1,959 out of 3,698 traded stocks ended session in red.

items.headline: SBI, PNB, Bank of Baroda: NIFTY PSU Bank index rallies up to 3.7% amid weak market; what’s powering PSU bank stocks?
items.summary: State-owned banking stocks or PSU banks surged during the trading session on Monday, November 9, as investors focused on the sectoral capital rotation into domestic value buying bets amid the overall profit-booking sentiment in the market.

items.summary: The project is expected to play a crucial role in supporting Noida’s expanding urban landscape and is likely to be completed within a stringent timeline of 36 months.

items.headline: HDFC Bank shares jump 2%, rally 12% in a month: Is leadership reset reviving investor confidence?
items.summary: The recent rally comes amid hopes that the appointment of Anup Bagchi as the bank's new MD and CEO will help restore investor confidence and steer the country's largest private sector lender through a challenging phase.

items.headline: Bharti Airtel overtakes Jio Platforms to reclaim title of 2nd most valuable company by market cap
items.summary: The market valuation of Bharti Airtel stood at ₹13.15 lakh crore as on November 6, 2026, while that of Jio Platforms was ₹12.94 lakh crore, according to data on the NSE.

items.headline: Diwali Bonanza: NIFTY50, SENSEX extend winning streak to seventh straight session; rally 8% in a week

items.headline: SENSEX jumps over 1,000 pts, NIFTY above 24,700; Havells, Tube Investment, M&M among buzzing stocks

items.headline: Indian IT stocks reverse early gains: NIFTY IT slips into red; Infosys, Wipro shares decline
items.summary: Shares of major IT companies, including Infosys, Tata Consultancy Services (TCS), Wipro and HCLTech, were trading higher, defying concerns stemming from the sharp decline in US technology stocks.

items.headline: Mahindra & Mahindra shares jump 5% for second day after Q2 show; what’s powering the auto stock?
items.summary: Mahindra & Mahindra shares surged for a second day straight on Friday, November 6, as investors focused on better-than-expected Q2 results. Experts predict further growth potential ahead with the help of the automaker's UV segment.

items.headline: Airtel vs Jio Platforms: Which telecom company leads on Q2 revenue, profit and ARPU?

A comparison of these two companies shows distinct strengths, with Airtel leading in higher revenue and ARPU, supported by its international business, while Jio Platforms leads in subscriber volume and profit margin.
